leaf_only_top20.description: Top50을 leaf로 필터한 뒤 fused rank 앞 20개

leaf_available_from_top50.description: 원래 Top50 안에서 leaf 필터 후 남은 전체; 가변 K

ranking.gte: stored logit descending, original rank, chunk ID

contract.candidate_count_median: standard median; average of the two middle values for even denominators

coverage_count_definitions.removed_from_top50_count: all original Top50 candidates absent from the variant pool
coverage_count_definitions.removed_card_or_page_count: original Top50 candidates removed because level is not section or benefit
coverage_count_definitions.excluded_leaf_tail_count: section/benefit candidates remaining after the fixed20 cutoff; zero for available variant

interpretation.comparison_note: Recovery is judged relative to unfiltered 0.4 Top50 strict MRR delta -0.1192 and answer-bearing MRR delta -0.0275.

limitations: Leaf-only recovery would not establish broad card-query quality.
Removing card/page chunks can lose parent context.
Both variants remain bounded by the original stored Top50.
This adaptive development diagnostic does not alter the existing GTE decision.

korean_glossary.leaf_only_top20: 원래 Top50을 section/benefit으로 필터한 뒤 fused rank 앞 20개
korean_glossary.leaf_available_from_top50: 원래 Top50 안에서 section/benefit 필터 후 남은 전체를 쓰는 가변 K; Top50 자체가 아님
korean_glossary.candidate ceiling: 고정 후보 안에서 가능한 관련 청크 회수 상한
korean_glossary.candidate_count_median: 짝수 개이면 가운데 두 값 평균을 쓰는 표준 중앙값
korean_glossary.removed_from_top50_count: 원래 Top50 중 최종 variant 후보에 들지 못한 전체 수
korean_glossary.removed_card_or_page_count: section/benefit이 아니어서 제거된 card/page 후보 수
korean_glossary.excluded_leaf_tail_count: leaf이지만 fixed20 뒤라 제외된 후보 수; available에서는 0
